DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の予約をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to book a consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の相談です。日本語が苦手なので、私の名前で予約して二人で来ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の相談を自分名義で予約できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for my friend. Their Japanese isn't strong, so should I book it under my name and have us both come?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can book your friend's consultation under your own name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談するご本人のお名前と、付き添う方の役割を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the name of the person receiving the consultation separately from the accompanying person's role.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の相談として登録するのは違いますね。本人の了解を得て予約を手伝っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の同意を得た予約補助だと役割を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Registering it as my own consultation would be wrong, wouldn't it? I'm helping with the booking with their consent.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your role by explaining that you are helping book with the person's consent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 希望する相談内容の大まかな分野と、言語を教えてください。通訳の対応は確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us the general topic of the consultation and the language requested. We need to check interpreter availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住居についての相談で、本人はベトナム語を希望しています。私が来られる日は限られるので、通訳の可否も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談分野と言語希望を伝え通訳の可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's about housing, and my friend would like Vietnamese. There are only certain days I can come, so I'd also like to know whether an interpreter is available.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the consultation topic and preferred language and ask about an interpreter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に確認します。あなたが説明を代わりに決めるのでなく、本人の希望を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with the staff member. Can you confirm your friend's wishes, rather than deciding what to explain on their behalf?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私の空いている日だけで予約を決めず、本人に候補日と通訳の確認状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の希望日を確認してから選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't choose a booking only from the days I'm free. I'll tell my friend the possible dates and the current status of the interpreter inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will check the person's preferred dates before choosing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約が成立するには、その返事と窓口側の確認が必要です。今は希望の受付として記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We need that reply and confirmation from our office before the booking is established. For now, we'll record it as a request.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。予約確定とは伝えず、本人の名前と希望を確認してから返事します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確定と理解し本人情報確認後に返答すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't tell them the booking is confirmed. I'll reply after checking their name and preferences.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show you understand it is unconfirmed and will reply after checking the person's information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、連絡方法をご案内します。付き添いの有無も返事の際にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll explain how to contact us. When you reply, please also tell us whether someone will accompany them.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 注文メモの内容をご確認いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you check the order notes?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: えびを取り消したはずですが、まだ書かれています。えびを避ける必要があるので、調理前か確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 避ける料理がメモに残り調理前か確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I'd canceled the shrimp, but it's still written here. I need to avoid shrimp, so please check whether cooking has started.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a dish you need to avoid remains on the notes and ask whether cooking has started. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 調理の進行と取り消しの伝達状況を担当に確認します。ほかの料理も含めて確認が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask the staff member about the cooking progress and whether the cancellation was communicated. Do we need to check the other dishes too?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。野菜なら問題ないと自分で判断せず、油や調理器具についても説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 野菜も油や器具を含め説明が必要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Rather than deciding myself that vegetables are fine, I'd like an explanation about the oil and cooking utensils too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the vegetables also need an explanation covering oil and utensils. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。材料だけでなく調理条件も担当に伝えます。ここで対応を保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. I'll tell the staff member about the cooking conditions as well as the ingredients. I can't guarantee what we can accommodate here.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 説明まで、私の注文全体を進めないよう担当に伝えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明まで自分の注文全体を止めるよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you tell the staff member not to proceed with any of my order until I receive the explanation?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for your whole order to be held until you receive an explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 伝えます。ご同行の方の注文と区別するため、どちらがあなたの分か確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will. Let's check which items are yours so we can distinguish them from your companion's order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この野菜と、取り消しをお願いしたえびが私の分です。隣の方の注文は私が変更するものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分と同行者の注文範囲を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: These vegetables and the shrimp I asked to cancel are mine. The person next to me's order isn't mine to change.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the scope of your order from your companion's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が状態を確認して来ます。注文メモだけで取り消し完了と扱わずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will check the situation and come over. Please wait without treating the cancellation as completed based on the order notes alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。調理の状態と対応範囲を聞き、自分の分をどうするか決めます。取り消しが伝わったかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実際の状態と伝達を確認してから注文を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll hear about the cooking status and what can be accommodated before deciding what to do with my items. I'll also check whether the cancellation was passed on.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide about the order after confirming the actual situation and communication. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。あなたの分を区別して担当へ報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll distinguish your items when reporting to the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 費用表で分かりにくい項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any entries on the fee table that are unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃と管理費に鍵交換の欄も足しました。毎月この合計を払うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一回の鍵交換費を月額に含めた計算を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I added the lock replacement charge to the rent and management fee. Will I pay that total every month?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check your calculation that includes a one-time lock replacement fee in the monthly total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この見積りでは、鍵交換は入居時の一回の費用として示しています。月額の欄とは分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this estimate, lock replacement is shown as a one-time cost at move-in. It's separate from the monthly column.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一回の費用を毎月の支払いへ混ぜていました。月額合計と入居時合計を別に示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 月額と入居時の合計を分けて提示してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had mixed a one-time cost into the monthly payment. Could you show the monthly total and move-in total separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for separate totals for monthly charges and move-in costs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つに分けて説明します。ただし、これは見積りで、契約条件の確認はまだです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll explain them separately. However, this is an estimate; the contract conditions haven't been confirmed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この金額で契約が確定したとは扱いません。更新時の費用は今の二つの合計に含まれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見積り未確定と認め更新費の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't treat the contract as finalized at this price. Are renewal costs included in either of those two totals?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the estimate is unconfirmed and ask how renewal costs are treated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 更新については別の条件欄です。期間と金額の記載を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Renewal is in a separate conditions section. Let's check the period and amount listed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 毎月、入居時、更新時の三つに分けてメモします。口頭の説明と書面で違うところがあれば聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三つの支払時期で整理し書面と照合すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll make notes under three headings: monthly, move-in and renewal. If anything differs between the spoken explanation and the documents, I'll ask again.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Organize the three payment timings and say you will compare them with the documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今日は契約を進めるか、説明を持ち帰るか、どうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Would you like to proceed with the contract today or take the explanation home?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見積りと条件の説明を持ち帰り、三つの時期ごとに予算を確認します。今日は申込みを確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料を持ち帰り予算確認前は申込みを確定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the estimate and conditions explanation home and check my budget for each of the three timings. I won't finalize an application today.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the documents home and leave the application unconfirmed until you check your budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認する項目を記した資料をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll give you documents showing the points to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約された機器をご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to use the equipment you reserved?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。初めてなので、予約の時間に指導員が使い方を教えてくれると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 機器予約に指導が含まれると思ったことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It's my first time, so I thought an instructor would teach me how to use it during my reserved time.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought instruction was included in the equipment reservation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その枠は機器の利用予約です。指導員の説明予約とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: That slot is for using the equipment. It's separate from an appointment for an instructor's explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 説明が付いている枠ではなかったのですね。操作が分からないので、今は機器を動かしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 操作不明なので起動しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So that slot didn't include an explanation. I don't know how to operate it, so I won't start the equipment now.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not start it because you do not know how to operate it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 初回案内を受ける方法を確認します。これまでの利用経験はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check how you can receive the first-time guidance. Have you used it before?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の機器は使いましたが、この機器はありません。似ているから同じ操作だとは考えず教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当該機器は未経験と申告し説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've used other equipment, but not this one. I won't assume it works the same just because it looks similar; I'd like you to teach me.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that you have no experience with this equipment and request an explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明担当が案内できる時刻を確認します。予約時間を待つだけで説明が来るとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check when the person providing explanations is available. Just waiting for your reserved time doesn't necessarily mean someone will come to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では利用枠の扱いも聞きたいです。案内を受ける前に時間だけ延ばすのではなく、予約窓口で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明前の利用枠の扱いを窓口に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'd like to ask how my usage slot will be handled too. Rather than simply extending the time before receiving guidance, I'll discuss it with the booking desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss with the desk how to handle your usage slot before instruction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から説明と予約の両方を案内します。体調など、利用前に伝えることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain both the instruction and the booking. Is there anything to mention before use, such as your physical condition?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は特に申告したい変化はありませんが、利用条件も説明で確認します。案内後に使うか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用条件を確認してから使用を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: There aren't any particular changes I want to report today, but I'll also check the usage conditions during the explanation. I'll decide whether to use it afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide whether to use it after checking the conditions of use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では機器から離れた待機場所へどうぞ。説明ができる担当を呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to the waiting area away from the equipment. I'll call someone who can explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗車券の画面を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you show me your ticket screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この画面です。今朝、出発便を変更しましたが、スクリーンショットならすぐ見せられると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 便変更後に古いスクリーンショットを提示したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here it is. I changed my departure service this morning, but I thought I could show a screenshot quickly.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you showed an old screenshot after changing your service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは変更前の便です。変更後の乗車券を開けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This shows the service before your change. Can you open the updated ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 古い画面を出していました。購入サイトに入り、変更後の便が反映されているか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入サイトで変更後の券を開き確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was showing the old screen. I'll go into the purchase site and check that the changed service is reflected.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Open the updated ticket on the purchase site and check it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この画面が変更後ですね。出発時刻と乗り場を案内表示で照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This screen is the updated one. Please compare the departure time and boarding point against the information display.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 便は確認できました。座席も前の十二番のままだと思っていましたが、今は十八番と表示されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 便だけでなく新しい座席番号も読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've confirmed the service. I thought my seat was still number twelve, but it now shows number eighteen.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reread the new seat number as well as the service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗車時は現在の券の案内に従ってください。古い便の列には並ばないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: When boarding, follow the instructions on your current ticket. Make sure you don't join the line for the old service.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古い列へは戻りません。同行者には以前の座席で探さないよう、今の便と十八番を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 古い列を避け同行者へ便と座席の変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't go back to the old line. I'll tell my companion the current service and seat eighteen so they don't look for me at my old seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid the old line and tell your companion about the service and seat changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。乗り場の案内が変更された場合は、当日の表示や係員に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If the boarding-point information changes, check the day's display or ask a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変更後の券を開いたまま、当日の乗り場を確認します。古い画像は今回の提示に使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日の乗り場を確認し現在の券だけ提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the updated ticket open and check today's boarding point. I won't use the old image as my ticket this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the day's boarding point and present only the current ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備ができたら、その便の案内に従ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once you're ready, please proceed following the instructions for that service.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この欄に、送金の目的を記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please enter the purpose of the transfer in this field.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相手の口座番号を書きました。送金先の情報を聞かれたと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 目的欄に口座番号を書いた誤りを申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the recipient's account number. I thought you were asking for the destination account information.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you mistakenly entered an account number in the purpose field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座情報は別の欄です。ここでは、何の支払いかを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: The account information goes in a different field. Here, we check what the payment is for.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 学費の支払いです。目的欄にある番号はその説明ではないので、修正方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 学費目的を述べ訂正方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's for school fees. The number in the purpose field doesn't explain that, so please tell me how to correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that the purpose is school fees and ask how to correct the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 訂正方法は担当がご案内します。学費の案内や請求書はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will show you how to correct it. Do you have a school fee notice or invoice?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 請求書を持っています。送金額には授業料以外の寮費もあるので、学費だけと書いてよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 授業料と寮費の内訳を示し目的表現を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the invoice. The transfer includes dormitory fees as well as tuition, so I'd like to check whether it's okay to write only school fees.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the tuition and dormitory fee breakdown and ask how to describe the purpose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内訳を担当へ見せてください。目的や必要書類を、この窓口で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show the staff member the breakdown. We'll check the purpose and required documents at this desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では授業料と寮費の二つを示します。審査が済んだことにはせず、提出前に説明を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二つの目的を説明し未確認で提出しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll show both the tuition and dormitory fees. I won't treat the screening as completed, and I'll get an explanation before submitting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain both purposes and say you will not submit without checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取人の情報についても、別の欄で確認します。目的欄の数字を移せば完了とは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also check the recipient information in a separate field. Simply moving the numbers out of the purpose field may not complete everything.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。番号も請求書と照合し直し、目的と受取人情報を別々に確認してから提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 目的と口座情報を別に照合してから提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll compare the number with the invoice again and submit only after checking the purpose and recipient information separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the purpose and account information separately before submitting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へおつなぎします。修正前の用紙もそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll refer you to the staff member. Please also bring the uncorrected form as it is.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作品についてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the artwork?

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 白く盛り上がった所があります。展示中に汚れたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 原画の白い跡を展示汚れか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a raised white patch. Did it get dirty while on display?
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a white mark on the original artwork is dirt from the exhibition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 原画の制作過程に関係する跡の場合があります。作品の解説を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-03.translation: It may be a mark related to the original artwork's production process. Let's check the explanation of the work.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙の損傷と決めていました。触って確かめず、解説でこの部分を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 損傷断定と接触を避け解説を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had decided it was damage to the paper. Rather than touching it to check, I'd like to learn about this part from the explanation.
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid declaring it damage or touching it, and request an explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この解説では描き直した部分と案内しています。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-05.translation: This explanation identifies it as a part that was redrawn.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 印刷された本で見えなかった理由も知りたいです。原画と完成した印刷ページを比べられますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原画と印刷ページの比較先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd also like to know why I couldn't see it in the printed book. Is there somewhere to compare the original artwork and the finished printed page?
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where you can compare the original artwork and the printed page. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 比較用の展示は向こうです。撮影条件は別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-07.translation: The comparison display is over there. Please check the photography conditions separately.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 展示の理解のために比較します。違いを見つけても印刷ミスと決めず、制作の説明を読みます。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見た差を印刷ミスと断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll compare them to understand the exhibition. Even if I find differences, I won't decide they're printing errors; I'll read the explanation of the production process.
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid declaring the differences you see to be printing errors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からない所があれば、作品名を示して聞いてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-09.translation: If anything is unclear, please ask and give the name of the work.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。原画の修正跡と印刷後の見え方を分けてメモし、撮影するなら先に条件を聞きます。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 制作跡と印刷を分け記録し撮影条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll make separate notes on the original artwork's correction marks and how it looks in print, and ask about the conditions first if I want to take photos.
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record production marks separately from printing and check photography conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では比較展示へどうぞ。原画には触れずご覧ください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to the comparison display. Please look without touching the original artwork.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 表示のことでお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the sign?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 対象年齢より小さい子ですが、私が大人なので一緒なら使えると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大人同伴なら年齢条件を満たすと思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child is younger than the stated age, but I thought they could use it with me since I'm an adult.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought adult accompaniment would satisfy the age condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示は利用する子の条件です。大人の年齢に置き換えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sign gives the conditions for the child using it. Please don't substitute the adult's age.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 付き添う人の年齢ではなかったのですね。まだ乗せていません。子の年齢に合う場所を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未使用と伝え子の条件に合う場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it wasn't the accompanying person's age. I haven't put my child on it yet. I'd like to ask about a place suitable for their age.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it has not been used and ask for a place that meets the child's conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の遊び場の案内を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can check information about another play area.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ形の遊具なら条件も同じとは考えず、そちらでも表示を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 形の類似と条件一致を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume similar-looking play equipment has the same conditions. I'll read the signs there too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish a similar shape from matching conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現地の案内と状態を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the instructions and conditions at the location.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。子だけ先に走らせず、一緒に移動して使える範囲を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子と一緒に移動して表示確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't let my child run ahead alone; we'll go together and check which areas they can use.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Go together with the child and check the signs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内図はこちらです。使えない遊具へ持ち上げて乗せる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's the map. There's no need to lift them onto equipment they're not eligible to use.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ち上げて使わせることはしません。子の条件に合う遊び場を確認してから遊びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持ち上げて対象外遊具を使わせず適合を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't lift them onto it to let them use it. We'll play after checking a play area that meets my child's conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid lifting the child onto ineligible equipment and check suitability. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では案内された場所で表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please check the signs at the place you've been directed to.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a mat?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 裏が滑り止めなので、壁へ貼って小物を置けると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 滑り止めを壁用接着と考えた用途を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Since the back is nonslip, I thought I could stick it to a wall and put small items on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe your intended use based on mistaking nonslip backing for wall adhesive. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 滑り止めと接着面は別です。用途の表示を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nonslip backing and an adhesive surface are different. Please look at the intended-use label.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 壁用の棚になる物ではないのですね。まだ買わず、平らな所へ敷く用途を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 棚になる誤解を直し敷く用途を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it isn't something that becomes a wall shelf. I won't buy it yet; I'll check its use as a mat on a flat surface.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct the misunderstanding that it becomes a shelf and check its use as a mat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品は置き場所の条件も表示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: This product also lists conditions for where it can be placed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 棚の上に敷きたいですが、棚の材質が分かりません。相性を自分で決めず家で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 棚材質未確認を述べ適合を調べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to put it on a shelf, but I don't know what the shelf is made of. I won't decide compatibility myself; I'll check at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that the shelf material is unconfirmed and check compatibility. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品名と注意書きを控えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can note down the product name and precautions.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 控えます。大きい品を載せるから二枚を貼り合わせようとも思いましたが、その使い方はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 注意を控え貼合せ自己加工をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. I was also thinking of sticking two together because I'd put a large item on them, but I won't use them that way.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note the precautions and abandon joining the mats together yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 寸法と用途を確認してから選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the dimensions and intended use before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。家の棚を確認し、表示の範囲で使えると分かってから購入します。今日は持ち帰りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家庭の条件確認まで購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll check my shelf at home and buy it once I know it can be used within the label's conditions. I won't take it home today.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off on buying until you have checked the conditions at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では商品はこちらで戻します。表示を控えてご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll put the product back. Please note the label and consider it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のお名前を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I have the name on your reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 午前に焼き上がりの時間を聞きました。聞いた時点で一つ残してもらえると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 焼上り時刻を聞くだけで取置きと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I asked this morning what time it would finish baking. I thought asking meant you would keep one for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought merely asking the baking time meant an item was being held. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 時間の案内と取置きの受付は別です。お名前や数量を申し込まれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Giving the time and accepting a hold request are separate. Did you provide your name and quantity?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 申し込んでいません。時間だけ聞いたので、予約済みとは言えませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名前数量未申込と認め予約と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I didn't make a request. I only asked the time, so I can't say I already have a reservation, can I?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you did not give a name or quantity and distinguish that from a reservation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の在庫を確認します。ご希望は一つですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the current stock. Would you like one?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、一つです。売切れなら、誰かの予約分を回してほしいとは頼みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望数を伝え他人の予約分を要求しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, one. If it's sold out, I won't ask you to give me something reserved for someone else.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the quantity you want and avoid requesting someone else's reserved item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は一つ販売できます。今後の取置き条件も聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can sell you one now. You can also ask about the conditions for holding items in future.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日はその一つを買います。次回は時間を聞くだけでなく、取置き可否と申込方法を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現販売品を買い次回の取置き方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll buy that one today. Next time, rather than just asking the time, I'd like to check whether you can hold one and how to request it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Buy the item currently available and ask how to arrange a hold next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次回の受付方法をご案内します。今日の分はこの商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll explain how to make a request next time. This is today's item.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日の一つを確認して払い、次回は受付確認ができてから予約済みと考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日購入と次回受付確認を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll check and pay for today's one, and next time I'll consider it reserved only after confirming that the request has been accepted.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish today's purchase from confirming acceptance next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにご確認ください。本日分をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check in that way. I'll hand you today's item.
